hypothesis_timing: Secondary follow-up fixed after examining completed frozen-transfer results, before adaptation test results

source_graph.feature_provenance: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.
source_graph.positive_policy: Sum symmetrically normalized graph-local binary metapath adjacency; rank off-diagonal neighbors, at most 8; include self; all variants use the identical fixed positives.
source_graph.projection_validation: Every sampled row verified by independent raw-relation path traversal, without released metapath/positive matrices.

target_graph.feature_provenance: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.
target_graph.positive_policy: Sum symmetrically normalized graph-local binary metapath adjacency; rank off-diagonal neighbors, at most 8; include self; all variants use the identical fixed positives.
target_graph.projection_validation: Every sampled row verified by independent raw-relation path traversal, without released metapath/positive matrices.

feature_boundary: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.

initial_training.learning_rate_selection: Original fixed base rate; no source/target label tuning and no full-graph selected rates
initial_training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum pre-update training SSL loss, never target labels

target_training.learning_rate_selection: Original fixed base rate .0008; no additional tuning
target_training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum target-only phase SSL training loss, never labels
target_training.optimizer: Fresh Adam; no source optimizer state

copy_verification.transferred: Only fc[0] and MP encoder; NG, SM, ContraNorm/LayerNorm, auxiliary identity projections, contrastive projector, and Adam are freshly initialized for target graph

label_use: Only downstream probes after both SSL phases and frozen inference; target SSL does use unlabeled target graph/features
training_budget: Two SSL phases each up to 600 epochs; first graph is source or target according to initial_graph. No equal-total-cost claim versus one-phase target-only reference
